rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for finding a solution to a problem.

example.english: We need to resolve this problem today.
example.traditional: 呢個問題我哋今日要解決。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 gaai2 kyut3

rows.note: Use this when someone firmly resolves or determines to do something.

example.english: I resolve to lose weight this year.
example.traditional: 我下定決心今年一定要減肥。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 ding6 kyut3 sam1 gam1 nin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaam2 fai6

rows.note: Use this when people talk or negotiate until a disagreement or matter is settled.

example.english: We resolve the matter by talking it out.
example.jyutping: gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 king1 dim6 zo2 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when people repair a relationship and make peace after falling out.

example.english: They finally resolve their differences after their argument.
example.traditional: 佢哋鬧交之後終於和好喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 naau6 gaau1 zi1 hau6 zung1 jyu1 wo4 hou2 laa3
